sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Vijay Raj Bishnoi

For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.S. Bhati, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 16/04/2024 This anticipatory bail application has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with FIR No.77/2024, registered at Police Station Gangapur (Bhilwara),
District Bhilwara for the offences under Sections 366 & 376-D of the IPC.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the FIR, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prosecutrix has levelled specific allegation of she being subjected to forcible sexual assault-rape on 09.02.2024 at Indore against the co-accused persons namely Vinod Mali and Deepak @ Devraj Mali.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that from the bare perusal of the FIR, it is evident that the present petitioner had left the company of the prosecutrix and the other co-accused persons on 05.02.2024 and had returned to Gangapur.

[2024:RJ-JD:16472] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-4290/2024] Learned counsel for the petitioner further submitted that a bare perusal of the FIR, would indicate that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case and on the entire record, there is not even an iota of evidence indicating the petitioner's involvement in commission of the alleged crime.
The matter requires consideration.
Lokesh vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:16472) on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154156653/
1
Learned Public Prosecutor is directed to call for the case dairy, on the next date of hearing.

In the meanwhile and till next date of hearing, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.77/2024, registered at Police Station Gangapur (Bhilwara), District Bhilwara for the offences under Sections 366 & 376-D of the IPC.
However, the petitioner is further directed to appear before the Investigating Officer on 06.05.2024, at 11:30 AM.
